# tenancy.RegionalSettings

<!-- Generated by `pnpm contracts:catalog`. Do not edit. -->

Locale, display time zone, node time zone and currency resolved for a user at a node.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Id | `tenancy.RegionalSettings` |
| Kind | `view` |
| PII | `none` |
| Tenancy scope | `user` |

## Fields

| Field | Required | PII | Description | UI |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `currency` | yes | `none` | Default currency for new amounts at the node (unit, project, organization). |  |
| `displayTimeZone` | yes | `none` | Time zone to display dates in: user preference, else nodeTimeZone. |  |
| `locale` | yes | `none` | User preference, else the organization default. |  |
| `nodeTimeZone` | yes | `none` | Time zone of the node (unit, project, organization) for calendar rules. |  |
